scenario: Fresh named static/media Docker volumes mounted as in compose.production.yml, candidate image default non-root user UID 10001. Network disabled, synthetic process-local SECRET_KEY, no DB access.
impact: A fresh Compose deployment cannot collect static assets; the same fresh media mount is not writable for uploads. Existing volumes that were manually initialized with different ownership were not inspected.
cleanup: Both temporary volumes and the probe container were removed.
